# Version 4.151.0 (Unreleased)
> **Graphite GPU backend and new platforms**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.1 adds the new Graphite GPU backend for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, plus Nano Server font support. The new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package and Graphite bindings bring the next-generation Skia GPU engine to .NET consumers. Nano Server gains font rendering via FreeType, async pixel read-back lands for SKImage and SKSurface, and several hot allocation paths are eliminated.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Graphite GPU backend: Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn** — The new Skia Graphite rendering engine is now exposed via managed bindings. A dedicated SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package ships Vulkan support, with Metal and Dawn accessible through the same Graphite API surface. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968), [#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))
- **Skia m151 stability fixes** — Additional upstream chrome/m151 bug fixes and a Skia submodule/cgmanifest sync to pick up the latest stability improvements. ([#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4537](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4537), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568))

## API Surface

- **Async RequestReadPixels on SKImage and SKSurface** — New backend-neutral async pixel read-back allows reading pixels from GPU-backed images and surfaces without stalling the GPU pipeline. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **Binding generation made deterministic across platforms** — The native binding generator now produces identical output regardless of the host OS, eliminating spurious diffs when regenerating on different platforms. ([#4612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4612))
- **Performance: SKData.SaveTo and SKRuntimeEffectUniforms** — SKData.SaveTo avoids a double buffer copy on the hot save path, and SKRuntimeEffectUniforms pre-sizes its internal uniform lookup map to the known count, removing repeated resizing. ([#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512))
- **Performance: allocation-free GetEncodedText null-terminated path** — The null-terminated code path in GetEncodedText no longer allocates an intermediate string, reducing allocations in text measurement loops. ([#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498))

## Bug Fixes

- **CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak in SKImage.Create fixed** — The raster failure path in SKImage.Create leaked a CoTaskMem-allocated pixel buffer when the native image creation failed. The buffer is now always freed. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))

## Platform

- **Nano Server font support via FreeType** — SkiaSharp now uses FreeType for font rendering on Nano Server, where GDI is unavailable, enabling text drawing in Windows Server Core and Nano Server container workloads. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))
- **Containerized test legs: Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, Nano Server** — CI now runs tests inside Azure Linux, Alpine (musl libc), and Nano Server containers, validating native library compatibility across lightweight and minimal Linux/Windows environments. ([#4515](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4515))
- **Windows: MSVC environment initialized once per native build** — The MSVC toolchain environment is now set up once at the start of a native build rather than per-step, improving build reliability and speed on Windows. — ❤️ [@mmitche](https://github.com/mmitche) ([#4570](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4570))
